# EXPOSER

> Free, 100% client-side online metadata viewer, EXIF inspector, GPS location radar, and privacy sanitizer for images, audio, video, and documents.

EXPOSER runs entirely in the browser using HTML5 Web APIs and JavaScript with zero server uploads or telemetry.

## Tools and Features

- [Web Application](https://daceluffy.github.io/metadata-exposer/): In-browser metadata inspector, GPS radar, and EXIF sanitizer tool.
- [Sample Photo](https://daceluffy.github.io/metadata-exposer/sample_photo_with_gps.jpg): Sample JPEG test image with embedded EXIF and GPS tags.

## Documentation

- [Project Documentation](https://github.com/daceluffy/metadata-exposer/blob/main/README.md): Technical documentation, supported formats, and verification guides.
- [Source Code](https://github.com/daceluffy/metadata-exposer): GitHub open-source code repository.
